# TUI capability inventory (dashboard parity)

Read-only audit of the repo at origin/main 787436b. Sources checked: `src/app.rs` (slash table, key/mouse/paste handlers, overlays), `src/settings.rs`, `src/main.rs`, `src/cli.rs`, `src/web/parity.rs`, `src/web/server.rs`, `src/web/commands.rs`, `src/web/snapshot.rs`, and `src/web/assets/{session,app,memory,workspace,docs}.js` plus `index.html`. Line numbers are from that tree.

`src/web/parity.rs` (`PARITY`, lines 20–136) is the checked-in matrix. Each `control` id is declared in `session.js` (`button`/`picker` helpers, `data-parity`, or `PARITY_IDS` at lines 699–704). The matrix is incomplete and two rows disagree with the TUI (see the notes on Ctrl+O and Shift+Enter).

**Status** is whether the dashboard can do the TUI thing:

- **full** — a dashboard control calls the same behavior.
- **partial** — a control exists, but a TUI behavior is dropped, wrong, or only a hint.
- **missing** — no dashboard control does it.

**Scope caveat on "full".** `POST /api/prompt` and `POST /api/command` run only when the process has a command channel. That channel is created solely by `dmuxai --web` (`src/main.rs:768–813`, `commands: Some(sender)`). `dmuxai serve` sets `commands: None` (`src/main.rs:489–496`) and both routes return **409** `requires dmuxai --web` (`src/web/server.rs:929–931`, `970–972`). The JS then treats `snap.source === 'files'` as view-only and disables the chat controls (`session.js:849–860`). So a **full** row means "the page does this while the TUI is still running." It does not mean the TUI can be removed. Exceptions that hit the vault, the to-do database, or MCP directly (no `App`) are marked in the Notes column.

The TUI never writes `dmuxai.toml`. It only reads `DmuxSettings` (`src/settings.rs:193–316`). The one in-memory write is `run_headless` forcing `graph_enabled` (`src/app.rs:4806–4810`), and that is not flushed to disk.

## Headless mode

`dmuxai serve` is the only mode that opens the dashboard without a terminal UI. It does not run prompts or session commands.

- Startup is `CliAction::Serve` → `run_serve` (`src/main.rs:353`, `436`). The usage line says "Run the local dashboard server without the TUI" (`97`).
- The hub source is `SnapshotSource::Files` (`515`). `session` is documented as absent for `serve` and for headless runs (`src/web/snapshot.rs:38–40`). `session.js` hides the live chat and shows "View-only: start dmuxai --web to chat from the browser." (`260–263`, `849–860`).
- `DashboardServices.commands` is `None` (`489–496`). `post_prompt` (`914–931`) and `post_command` (`966–972`) both return 409 `{"error":"requires dmuxai --web"}` before any agent work. The same 409 is what `POST /api/todos/{id}/run` returns (`875–877`). A unit test posts `/api/prompt` with no sender and expects that body (`2820–2837`).
- `dmuxai --web` is the opposite: TUI plus server, `web_attached: true`, command sender connected to `App::drain_dashboard_commands` (`src/app.rs:1319–1366`, `src/main.rs:768–813`). Slash text from the page is executed by `submit_prompt` (`1460–1465`). Picker actions are `handle_session_command` (`1677–1865`).
- `dmuxai` with no arguments is TUI only. It still builds a hub so the event log works, and it does not bind a port (`656–660`).
- `dmuxai run` / `todo run` call `App::run_headless` in-process (`src/cli.rs:551–611`). That path can execute a prompt, including slash commands, because it calls `submit_prompt` (`src/app.rs:4857–4859`). It does not listen on 7420 and it does not serve the dashboard. Ctrl+C cancels the run (exit 130).
- No mode serves an interactive dashboard that can accept `/api/prompt` or `/api/command` after the TUI is gone. Removing the TUI requires a new owner for `DashboardCommand` besides `App` in the terminal loop.

`serve` still does useful read and some write work that does not need the TUI: poll `.dmuxai` graph files every 500 ms (`552–559`), to-do CRUD, Jira base URL, MCP server list and import, memory get/save/approve/reject, event log read, and read-only docs preview (`467`). Workspace switching and directory browse are refused (`1228–1229`, `1341–1342`).

## parity.rs mismatches

- Ctrl+O is wired to `toggle_details` (`parity.rs:106–110`). The key toggles only the last activity group (`src/app.rs:2000–2002`). `/details` toggles every group (`3739–3740`).
- Shift+Enter is listed as a TUI binding (`parity.rs:26–30`). `handle_key` submits on Enter with no Shift test (`2042`). The newline behavior exists only in `session.js`.
- `/graph` is in `PARITY` and in the session command list (`src/app.rs:1657–1660`) but not in `SLASH_COMMANDS` (`113–189`), so the TUI popup never offers it.
- The matrix does not mention `/graph continue`, `/graph override`, `/remember` flags, `/memory approve|reject`, `/new <title>`, `/resume` prefix matching, `/agent <id>`, `/mode <mode>`, clipboard image paste, mouse selection, file-link click, input resize, attachment chips, or the status line.

## Counts

Row counts from the table above. "full" still depends on `dmuxai --web` unless the Notes column says the route works in `serve`.

| Status | Rows |
| --- | ---: |
| full | 41 |
| partial | 29 |
| missing | 17 |
| Total | 87 |

Largest gaps if the TUI is removed: there is no process that accepts `/api/prompt` or `/api/command`; Ctrl+O last-group details, expanded activity text, and `[ui]` visibility never reach the browser; clipboard PNG paste, paste-a-path attach, attachment chips, chat file-link clicks, selection copy, and prompt resize have no page equivalent; the graph gate hint points at the TUI and has no Continue button; workspace switch re-execs the TUI and is refused in `serve`.
